tagline: Travel with Confidence. Experience the Difference.
hero_description: Discover unforgettable journeys across Himachal, Uttarakhand and Manali with carefully planned travel packages.
about_text: Mountain Trails is a trusted, customer-focused travel company dedicated to making every mountain journey smooth, comfortable, affordable and memorable. We specialize in domestic tour packages, customized holidays and complete travel planning for families, groups and adventure seekers.
about_extra: With years of hands-on experience across North India's most loved destinations, we build every itinerary on trust, personalized service and clear pricing so you can travel with confidence.
vision: To be a respected name in mountain tourism, known for honest guidance, quality service and journeys travellers remember for years.
